errors.evidence: The machine-generated description provides the chart's purpose based on an external caption, but completely omits the actual title written on the chart, which is "段落乱序数据" (Paragraph disorder data).

errors.text_span: 图表的横轴代表作答准确率
errors.evidence: The image itself does not have a label for the x-axis. Stating that it represents "作答准确率" (response accuracy) is an interpretation from an external caption, not a description of the visual content of the figure. The figure provides no explicit label for this axis.
The description claims the y-axis has the label "题目个数" (number of questions), but the y-axis in the figure has no label at all.
The phrase "清晰地展示了" (clearly shows) is subjective and evaluative language that should be avoided in an objective description.
